stage: 3A Pilot v2: validation-only development pilot with a redesigned source regime (blueprint section 20). No TEST, no M3, no power analysis, no H3.
note_git: The git commit is not stored here (a file cannot contain the hash of the commit that contains it). The runner writes pilot_manifest.json with the commit hash, git_dirty and the sha256 of this file; it refuses to start if git_dirty is true.

VAL.links: background variability p=0.3 per non-B2 container

execution.note_parallel: Pilot v1: 4 parallel runs reached load 8.6 on 6 CPUs and caused timing failures; 1 run reached load 1.9. Two runs in parallel (expected load about 4) is used. Timing checks stay as frozen.

rf.selection: none: fixed a priori, not tuned on any data

isotonic.fit_on: CAL (RF scores of CAL sessions vs Y)

bootstrap.resample_train_runs: with replacement, n = number of TRAIN runs, all sessions kept
bootstrap.resample_cal_runs: separately, with replacement, n = number of CAL runs
bootstrap.width: w = Q_(1-kappa) - Q_kappa of the M calibrated probabilities (a bootstrap spread, not a confidence interval)

cost.use: descriptive only (H2 mechanistic indication, band degeneracy); no tuning

strata.kind: rank quartiles of s on VAL
strata.ties: broken by (run_id, session_id), never by Y

conditional_width.statistic: stratum-centred (within-stratum) Pearson correlation of w with e = Y - s, also with Y, also Spearman variant
conditional_width.per_run: same statistic computed in each VAL run

incremental_information.standardize: z-score fitted on the training folds
incremental_information.interval: run-cluster bootstrap of the 12 per-run differences, n_boot 10000
incremental_information.diff_definition: delta = metric(A) - metric(B); positive means w helps

determinism_of_w.statistic: leave-one-VAL-run-out R^2 of w regressed on rank(s) with k-nearest-neighbours, k = 25

permutation_reference.scheme: blueprint section 11, rank blocks m = 5 within run
permutation_reference.use: reference distribution of delta Brier when w carries no within-block information; descriptive

band_degeneracy.score_only_band: Bayes thresholds tau_CV, tau_VT of the primary costs applied to s (untuned)
band_degeneracy.non_degenerate_if: V share of VAL sessions >= 0.05 and C and T regions each non-empty

h2_mechanistic.statistic: share of VAL sessions whose [Q_kappa, Q_(1-kappa)] bootstrap range straddles tau_CV or tau_VT; share whose action differs between the two quantiles

h1_verdict_rule.SUPPORTED: all of: (i) mean per-run delta Brier > 0 with run-bootstrap one-sided 97.5% lower bound > 0; (ii) mean per-run delta log loss > 0; (iii) delta Brier > 0 in at least 8 of 12 held-out runs; (iv) conditional correlation of w with (Y - s) > 0 with run-bootstrap one-sided 97.5% lower bound > 0; (v) leave-one-run-out R^2 of w on s < 0.9
h1_verdict_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: all of: mean delta Brier <= 0; mean delta log loss <= 0; one-sided 97.5% lower bound of the conditional correlation <= 0

supersedes_note: Development Pilot v1 (configs/pilot_stage3a.json, results/raw/pilot_stage3a, results/pilot_stage3a) is preserved unchanged; its verdict H1-NOT-SUPPORTED-IN-PILOT stands. Pilot v2 uses fresh seeds and a different TRAIN/CAL composition only.

source_regime.known_benign_change: B1 (frozen generator, unchanged) in TRAIN and CAL, clean links
source_regime.unseen_benign_shift: B2 appears only in VAL (and later TEST)
source_regime.rationale: Pilot v1 showed that a source model trained on stable-benign versus malicious learns a stable-versus-changed shortcut. B1 is made a known benign family so that behavioural change alone does not mean malicious. This is a source-regime correction, not a change to improve w.

adequacy_gate.description: Before any bootstrap width or H1 diagnostic is computed, require Brier(s on VAL) < Brier(constant predictor p0 on VAL), where p0 = mean Y over TRAIN and CAL sessions (development prevalence, not VAL prevalence).
adequacy_gate.on_failure: stop: write the score diagnostics and the gate result; compute no width, no H1; no RF/calibration/uncertainty change is allowed
adequacy_gate.no_tuning: RF and calibration are not tuned from VAL results

interpretation_rule: This is the only source-regime redesign allowed before TEST. If Pilot v2 again gives H1-NOT-SUPPORTED-IN-PILOT, this uncertainty direction stops. If H1 is supported, the next stage may be the power analysis and TEST LOCK (not executed here).
